sentences.en: The bank offers a special installment scheme for buyers of homes in Agus's project.
sentences.ko: 은행은 아구스가 짓는 단지의 주택 구매자에게 특별 할부 방식을 제공해요.

sentences.text: Toko itu menawarkan skema bayar nanti tanpa bunga selama tiga bulan.
sentences.en: The shop offers a buy-now-pay-later scheme with no interest for three months.
sentences.ko: 그 가게는 석 달 동안 무이자로 나중에 결제하는 방식을 제공해요.

sentences.text: Agus memilih tukang listrik itu berdasarkan rekomendasi dari teman lamanya.
sentences.en: Agus chose that electrician based on a recommendation from an old friend.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 오랜 친구의 추천을 받아 그 전기 기술자를 골랐어요.

sentences.text: Wati membeli lampu tidur berdasarkan rekomendasi dari seorang teman kantornya.
sentences.en: Wati bought a bedside lamp based on a recommendation from a coworker.
sentences.ko: 와티는 회사 동료의 추천을 받고 수면등을 샀어요.

sentences.text: Wati baru sadar ada pemotongan biaya ongkir saat memakai kode promo.
sentences.en: Wati only realized there was a shipping discount when she used the promo code.
sentences.ko: 와티는 프로모 코드를 쓰고 나서야 배송비가 깎인 걸 알았어요.

sentences.text: Teman Wati yang jadi akuntan bilang sebaiknya semua belanja daring dicatat.
sentences.en: Wati's friend who is an accountant says all online purchases should be recorded.
sentences.ko: 회계사인 와티의 친구는 온라인 구매를 전부 적어 두는 게 좋다고 해요.

sentences.text: Rak buku yang dipesan Wati dirancang oleh seorang arsitek muda.
sentences.en: The bookshelf Wati ordered was designed by a young architect.
sentences.ko: 와티가 주문한 책장은 젊은 건축가가 디자인했어요.

sentences.text: Wati memesan sampul ponsel bergambar kucing yang lucu.
sentences.en: Wati ordered a phone case with a cute cat picture on it.
sentences.ko: 와티는 귀여운 고양이 그림이 있는 휴대폰 케이스를 주문했어요.
